note: Review of the first version by a numbers verifier and a red team, with the answers (right / partly / wrong) and what each accepted change moved. Company research only.

bridge.change: beta 0.62 -> 0.59 (the locked rule's own script, 104 complete weeks)
working capital 30% -> 25% of added revenue (FY2025 and 9M 2026 pooled: 24%)
base tirzepatide 2032 86B -> 83B (US generic semaglutide possible from 2032)
calibrated lens: hand-set 24x removed, today's multiple held (34.9x on the model's EPS)

reviews.verdict: the verdict holds; the model rerun matched the saved result; two major and seven minor findings

findings.title: Calibrated lens applied a conventional-EPS multiple (24x) to the model's smaller EPS.
findings.outcome: override removed; the lens holds today's multiple (34.9x): 1,115 and +2.4% a year; 27.0x (hindsight five-year low, like for like) shown as a variant: 956 and -0.6%

findings.title: The multiple history is a hindsight series, not the forward multiple the market paid.
findings.outcome: labelled hindsight; like-for-like value 1,911 (1,456-2,306) shown next to the rule value 1,960 (1,494-2,365) and the calendar-year basis 1,620 (1,200-2,010); provider series is a gap

findings.title: Beta 0.62 is not the locked rule's reading (0.59).
Bull text quoted 139B of incretins in 2030; the driver table gives 145.5B.
Working-capital note cited the wrong year; 30% is above the 2026 cash flow.
findings.outcome: note corrected; input set to 25% (pooled FY2025 and 9M 2026: 24%); base +2.71

findings.title: Base 2027 sits at consensus, the low side of the company's record.
findings.outcome: wording corrected; no input change (no 2027 guide until January; the beat record is in the bull; value effect +3)

findings.title: Conventional-EPS conversion used the 2027 ratio for an exit-year multiple.
findings.outcome: 2032 ratio 1.168 used: 20x = 17.1x conventional; literal locked rule 45.2x = 1,315 and +5.8% a year

reviews.verdict: the verdict holds: not a buy; no evidenced change brings any leg near a pass

findings.title: The calibrated lens is on the wrong basis.
Far-year incretin revenue is above published forecasts, not cautious.
findings.outcome: text and probabilities changed (bull 25% -> 20%, base 50% -> 55%); base path not changed on this finding: the sources are secondary and predate the Q3 raise

findings.title: US generic semaglutide in 2032 is missing from the exit year.
findings.outcome: US expiry 2032 confirmed in Novo Nordisk's FY2023 20-F; base tirzepatide 2032 86B -> 83B, not the 80B proposed (entry date inside 2032 not settled; Lilly held share after generics outside the US); base -34.80

findings.title: The Medicare Bridge ends 31.12.2027 with no successor.
Near-term revenue sits under the run rate.
Risk-free rate 4.94% in force against a 5.15% yield on 13.11.
Small corrections: literal rule on the 2032 ratio; unsourced peer figures; the median covers only extreme-growth years.
findings.outcome: variant corrected; unsourced figures not published; longer own history is a gap
